name: playbook
description: Private marketplace for the shared Claude Code playbook — core rules, per-kind packs, and the compose engine that assembles a project's .claude/ from them.

plugins.name: playbook
plugins.description: Source + compose engine for the shared playbook. Bundles compose-claude.sh, core/ rules, and the per-kind packs, and provides /playbook:upgrade to (re)compose a project's .claude/ from the installed plugin. The per-session verbs (/status, /wrapup, /test, /conform, …) stay un-namespaced — they are written into the project by compose, not registered by this plugin.
